claims: KPop Demon Hunters 2 is officially in development at Netflix and Sony Pictures Animation.
Directors Maggie Kang and Chris Appelhans are returning for KPop Demon Hunters 2.
KPop Demon Hunters 2 is aiming for a 2029 release.
KPop Demon Hunters received a 2026 Oscar nomination.
KPop Demon Hunters 2 will continue the story of the idol-demon hunting group.
